entities.name: C2 communication authorization
entities.description: Network procedure for authorizing pairing between UAV and UAV-C before enabling user plane connectivity for C2 communication.

entities.name: UUAA-SM procedure
entities.description: UAS Unmanned Aerial System Authentication and Authorization procedure used to authorize C2 communication.

entities.name: UAV-C identification information
entities.description: Identification information of UAV-C provided by UE via protocol configuration options for pairing authorization.

entities.name: Pairing authorization successful
entities.description: Condition where pairing of UAV and UAV-C has been successfully authorized by USS.

entities.name: Pairing revoked
entities.description: Condition where pairing of UAV and UAV-C has been revoked.

entities.name: Enable C2 communication
entities.description: Network enables user plane connectivity for C2 communication after successful authorization.

entities.name: Disable C2 communication
entities.description: Network disables C2 communication when pairing is revoked, either by removing packet filters or deactivating EPS bearer context.

entities.name: Common PDN connectivity scenario
entities.description: Scenario where UE uses common PDN connectivity for both USS communication and C2 communication.

entities.name: Separate PDN connectivity scenario
entities.description: Scenario where UE uses separate PDN connectivity for USS communication and C2 communication.

relations.description: C2 communication authorization requires successful pairing authorization by USS.
Successful pairing authorization establishes enabled C2 communication.
Pairing revocation establishes disabled C2 communication.
C2 communication authorization uses UUAA-SM procedure for authorization.
C2 communication authorization may include UAV-C identification information provided by UE.
In common PDN scenario, UUAA-SM procedure is performed during PDN connectivity or bearer resource modification.
In separate PDN scenario, UUAA-SM procedure is performed during PDN connectivity procedure.
